note: Hand-curated from official government pages; rendered by tools/build_evac.ps1. Each item quotes its source exactly (short quotes; the proclamation in full) and records when it was read. Re-check every source each update run; never infer an order that a source does not state.

jurisdictions.name: Baldwin County, AL
jurisdictions.includes: Fairhope, Daphne, Foley, Gulf Shores, Orange Beach

orders.where: All locations in Baldwin County south of the Gulf Intracoastal Waterway, including Gulf Shores and Orange Beach
orders.by: Governor of Alabama (see the proclamation below)

orders.where: Coastal areas, and flood-prone and low-lying communities
orders.effective: Not stated on the county page
orders.quote: A voluntary evacuation is now in effect for: • Coastal areas • Flood-prone and low-lying communities

notes: The county page's headline reads "Mandatory Evacuation for all Areas South of Intracoastal Waterway". The order itself, and the Governor's proclamation, cover non-residents, tourists and visitors only.
Baldwin County EMA also lists Fort Morgan among the communities covered by the mandatory order.

Baldwin County's page does not define which "coastal areas" the voluntary evacuation covers. Its evacuation information page links the county's evacuation zone maps. Call the EMA to ask about a specific address.
shelters: Baldwin County Coliseum, 19477 Fairground Rd, Robertsdale. Opened Thu 3 PM; pet-friendly shelter at the same location.
St. Paul's Episcopal Church, 506 N. Pine St., Foley (a "Safer Place" run by volunteer groups). Opens Fri 6 AM; info 251-256-8202.
Transportation to shelters (BRATS), while conditions are safe: 251-972-6817.

Okaloosa County is asking all out-of-town visitors to evacuate from the forecast area of impacts

notes: The page also links the county's evacuation orders for residents and for visitors as separate documents; those documents were not opened for this page.
An update on the same page, as of 10:30 AM 8 Oct, words the resident order as covering "residents living in Zones A and B" without "coastal areas".
The page gives the shelter opening as both "Thursday, October 8" and "Thursday, October 9" in different places. Thursday is 8 October; check with the county.
County Water & Sewer is shutting off drinking water mains and sewage lift stations on Okaloosa Island starting at 12 PM Fri 9 Oct (county update, 9 AM 9 Oct).
shelters: Davidson Middle School, 6261 Old Bethel Rd, Crestview (general, special needs, pet-friendly) and the Raider Arena, Northwest Florida State College, 100 E College Blvd, Niceville. Listed as opening Thursday 6 PM.

proclamation.title: Supplemental proclamation by the Governor of Alabama, 8 October 2026: I. Mandatory evacuation of coastal tourists and visitors
text: Effective today, October 8, 2026, at 2:30 p.m. CDT, all non-residents, tourists, and visitors in the covered areas shall immediately evacuate themselves from the covered areas until the state of emergency expires or this order is modified in writing.

For purposes of this provision, “covered areas” means (1) all locations in Baldwin County south of the Gulf Intracoastal Waterway, including the City of Gulf Shores and the City of Orange Beach, and (2) all of Zone 1 in Mobile County, including all of Dauphin Island and parts of Bayou La Batre.
